nodes.label: Routing verification matrix
nodes.rationale: Tests cover heuristic selection, capability filtering, fallback safety, metadata gaps, persisted badges and stale events; they do not measure model quality, GPU memory or inference latency.

nodes.label: Automatic model switching
nodes.rationale: Select installed models deterministically using request complexity and size metadata, without an extra LLM call or automatic downloads.

nodes.label: Editor snapshot attachments
nodes.rationale: Source text is untrusted context, never approval; no background uploads.

nodes.label: Fallback before output or tool activity
nodes.norm_label: fallback before output or tool activity
nodes.rationale: Prevent replay of commands or file edits and keep the model fixed throughout a request.

nodes.label: GitHub-flavored Markdown
nodes.rationale: Safe standards-compliant rendering adds roughly 52 KB gzip while ignoring response HTML and remote images.

nodes.label: Local Windows dictation
nodes.rationale: System.Speech captures locally because VS Code webviews restrict microphone access; dictation never sends messages or runs commands automatically.

nodes.label: Ollama model residency
nodes.rationale: Automatic mode avoids unloading models used by other clients; conserve and keep are explicit opt-ins.

nodes.label: Project agent profiles
nodes.rationale: Project profiles add instructions but never grant tools or bypass trust, write review, or command approvals.

nodes.label: Copilot icon
nodes.rationale: Based on fully read SVG markup: a 24 by 24 currentColor outline with two eyes, curved smile, rounded head and antenna. No visual rendering was available.
